coaching.headline: Outkilled and out-sieged, eight structures to one. They played the map while we kept giving up the first body.
coaching.team: Every enemy Fangtooth fell with one of us already dead, which is a shit way to contest a pit. The ending ran the same way: Orb Prime and an inner tower fell right after Scarlett and Feng Mao died, both inhibitors fell with Scarlett down, and the Core followed a fight we lost 1-4. Their Genesis Core went uncontested with all five of us alive.
coaching.lossReflection: The better plan was to play the Fangtooth clock instead of the skirmishes around it. Resetting together before each spawn, with Feng Mao in front and Phase linked to Belica behind him, out of Riktor's first pull, gives either a full-strength contest or a clean cross-map trade for a tower. It does not guarantee the fight, but it stops conceding stacks while players are on the respawn timer.

focus.title: Turn won fights into structures
focus.evidence: Our two other wins came in the same window as our own outer towers falling and took nothing back; only the Primal Fangtooth win produced a prize, and objective damage ended 12,466 against 55,663.
focus.action: After any won fight or neutral objective, the living players hit the nearest enemy tower only when a friendly wave is there to tank it, and take a camp or reset otherwise. The next-game check is a structure taken within ninety seconds of each won fight.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Belica was the one player who turned up armed. Top hero damage on our side, farm well above her usual pace, and kills in two of our three won fights, including the Yurei kill right before our Primal Fangtooth. That is the standard. Two of her three deaths came after two or more of us were already down in that fight, so once two allies drop, Belica backs off toward tower instead of trading into Ikra or Grux.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: A rough Murdock, no argument. Damage per minute ran about a quarter under Goldilocks324's own norm, deaths ran over it, and Sparrow took three of his five deaths, including the opening kill of the last fight. Sting Operation gives him spare Static Traps, so when Sparrow is unseen before a fight or objective, Murdock lays traps on her approach first and only steps up once she has shown.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Being the team's healer and its crash test dummy is one job too many. Phase died first in three separate fights, to Riktor, Sparrow and Ikra in turn, so before any objective Phase keeps the link on Belica and stays behind her until the enemy shows its opener, Riktor's Riplash included. Mr_Meat31 still handled the healer half: solid healing, no deaths before minute 10, and a hand in just under half our kills.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Scarlett was a bloody mess: hero damage under a third of her usual, dead before two of their three Fangtooths. When Fangtooth is under a minute out and any of us is dead, Scarlett calls the pit off and takes a camp or tower elsewhere instead of joining a short-handed contest. She still led our objective damage and took the Riktor kill in the same window as our Primal Fangtooth.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs opened like a menace, taking first blood off Grux and killing him again early. Then the output went quiet: two takedowns out of our fifteen kills and no objective damage, while Grux finished with the most hero damage in the match. He died less than his usual; keep that. Once Grux and Riktor have both spent their pull, Feng Mao dashes onto Sparrow and saves Earth Shatter for her execute; until then he holds the front.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Duo lane against Sparrow and Riktor. Sparrow is a sustained-damage carry whose only escape is a short stealth with no dash; Riktor brings a pull, a silence and a suppress that catch whoever stands closest. Across the team, Grux and Yurei are the divers that reach an immobile backline, and four of five enemies dealt physical damage.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Necrosis adds ultimate haste and ultimate damage, so Long Arm of the Law comes back faster. Vanquisher executes heroes below 5% health. Nuclear Rounds scales ability damage with crit chance. Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic attacks, and it had targets: Grux and Ikra both finished with Terminus, a lifesteal item, and Yurei topped the match in healing. The path leans on abilities and crit in place of the Lightning Hawk and Imperator core.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays off on three basic attacks in a row on one hero, and Serration adds missing-health damage, which suits finishing Sparrow. Melting Point only pays against heavily armored targets, so it earns its slot only if the enemy builds real armor. Breach on the ultimate is the conditional alternative, giving up that bonus against tanks.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Sting Operation gives two extra Static Trap charges and larger traps. Against Grux and Yurei walking into the backline, more traps on the approach is the peel Murdock supplies himself. Keep it.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Pacifier adds a dash and an empowered hit that grows against low-health targets, with a reset on kills. Against Riktor's pull, holding the dash as the exit rather than the chase gives Murdock a way out of the catch. Keep.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: Keep the core damage items. If Sparrow and the divers keep reaching him, a defensive slot in place of Nuclear Rounds trades ability damage for survival, and his damage output was already below his norm. This match does not prove which death that item would have prevented.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.matchup: Duo lane against Sparrow and Riktor. Riktor is a catch support built around pull, silence and suppress, and he finished with the most damage mitigated in the match. Phase is a link enchanter whose escape is Phase Blink. The enemy drafted no healers, so Phase's ally healing was a tool they lacked, though Yurei's self-healing still topped the match.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Prophecy adds magic damage on basic attacks and Orion converts item ability haste into attack speed and stacks increased damage on a target its on-hit attacks land on, which pushes Phase toward basic-attack damage. Tainted Scepter cuts healing on magical damage and was our only magical anti-heal, against Terminus on Grux and Ikra and Yurei's match-high healing. Galaxy Greaves adds out-of-combat movement speed. The support core's Marshal and Enra's Blessing were skipped; Enra's shields an immobilized ally nearby, which is the exact Riktor case.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Lotus with Flawless heals Phase and nearby allies on ability hits, which suits a link healer. Prima Donna adds 10% damage to heroes but takes 6% more from all sources. On a support who died first in three fights, Immaculate is the conditional alternative: damage reduction above 85% health in exchange for the damage bonus.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.augment: Psychic Support restores the linked ally's mana through Essence Catalyst. It is strongest when the link sits on Belica, whose Runic Focus scales with current mana. Keep it if Belica is the link target.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.crest: Tranquility heals Phase and nearby heroes with brief damage mitigation and raises the ward cap to three. The group heal is the right answer to fights Riktor opens. Keep.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.improvement: Conditional swap: if Riktor keeps landing the first catch, replace Orion with Enra's Blessing, giving up basic-attack damage for a shield on the ally he locks down. Keep Tainted Scepter for the anti-heal.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Jungle against Yurei, a melee dive bruiser who chains resets onto marked targets; Yurei killed Scarlett twice. The softest gank targets were Sparrow, whose only escape is a short stealth with no dash, and Riktor. Across the team, four of five enemies dealt physical damage.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Manta Scythe boosts damage to minions and small monsters, grows permanently from camp leaders and siege minions, and hits isolated targets harder. Malady explodes killed units and adds damage to heroes below 40% health. Tainted Trident cuts healing on physical damage, and Yurei's match-high healing gave it a target. None of the three adds armor.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Demiurge raises item stats and item effect damage by 10%, and Tri-Core adds a small random on-hit bonus. Memory Leak grows max mana permanently and adds movement speed once her bonus max mana is high enough. Bloatware is the conditional alternative if survival is the problem, adding damage reduction per item at the cost of the mana and speed growth.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Coup De Grâce marks the Swan Song target and, if it dies within the window, extends Ablaze and drops a healing zone for Scarlett and allies. It pays only when the marked target dies fast, so it fits engages the team follows up. Keep it when the team commits behind her.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Nex adds a dash whose damage scales with damage stored in the last few seconds, so it rewards being in an ongoing fight. Keep.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: Supported conditional swap: against Yurei, Grux, Sparrow and Ikra all dealing physical damage, an armor item in place of Malady trades the low-health bonus damage and the kill explosion for survival. Zero armor and six deaths support it; the match does not prove which death it would have prevented.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Mid against Ikra, who ran a physical basic-attack build. Belica died once each to Ikra, Sparrow and Grux, so the physical damage dealers were the threats that actually reached her.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: On the core. Combustion procs on ability damage and recharges faster on hero hits. Noxia marks a hero on ability damage and bursts them when a separate ability lands, so any two-ability combo Belica lands on one target triggers it. Wraith Leggings adds damage to heroes below 40% health and Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion turns spell damage on heroes into gold and casts into mana regeneration. Bottomless Vial adds a potion charge and permanent magical power per river buff, and Runic Focus scales magical power with current mana. Philosopher is the alternative for steady gold if river buffs are contested. Keep.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience. On an immobile mage the speed is useful. Keep.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed on activation, a direct answer when Ikra or Grux reach her. Keep.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: Keep it. She sat on the full core and led our damage. If Yurei or Grux start reaching her, a defensive slot ahead of Oblivion Crown trades the late damage jump for survival; this match does not test that.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.matchup: Offlane against Grux, an engage bruiser with a pull, a dragging charge, a stun ultimate and bleeding basic attacks, built with Sky Splitter and Terminus lifesteal. Grux finished with the most hero damage in the match.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Manta Scythe boosts minion and small-monster damage and grows from camp leaders and siege minions. Omen empowers a basic attack after movement or attacks and cuts non-ultimate cooldowns. Tainted Trident cuts healing on physical damage, which hits Grux's lifesteal. No armor and no The Perforator, which ignores a share of physical armor.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Marrow heals from hero damage, Leech cuts nearby enemy base health regeneration, and Roses pays gold per takedown streak. With two takedowns, Roses had little to feed on. Blood Bank is the conditional alternative, turning hero damage into lifesteal at the cost of the takedown gold.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.augment: Ichorous Glaive restores missing health on kills and much more on Earth Shatter executions. It suits a diver who finishes targets like Sparrow. Keep.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.crest: Ortus gives movement speed and physical power on activation and permanent power on takedowns inside it. That is the tool for reaching Sparrow. Keep.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.improvement: Supported swap: an armor item in place of Manta Scythe once its farming job is done. Grux topped the match in hero damage and killed Feng twice. It gives up the minion and isolated-target damage; the match does not prove it saves a specific death.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
Dive threat on our backline: Yurei. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
enemyKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
enemyKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
enemyKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress
